Melfred Borzall HDD Tooling

The global leader in HDD tooling — supported locally by Blick.

Melfred Borzall has been engineering HDD tools for over 75 years. Every reamer, bit, and housing is built for productivity, reliability, and value — designed in California and supported here by Blick with local stock, competitive pricing, and field expertise.

When you buy Melfred Borzall through Blick, you get the world's best tooling with a team that knows your rigs, your ground, and your timelines.
